notes: D1 oracle is the official Translink G:link tram PDF (Effective August 2026) plus the 10 Aug 2026 SEQ diagram for ordered geography, HAND-TRANSCRIBED. Stations arrays are not generated from GTFS. H2 name-clash is against SEQ_GTFS.zip. No stopIds in this file.

City id gold-coast is a SEPARATE city from brisbane. Same SEQ Translink agency and same no-key GTFS/GTFS-RT, filtered to light rail (route_type=0 / L1). Do not merge into Brisbane T-lines or the QR Gold Coast heavy-rail corridor.
City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Modes v1: TRAIN-like light rail only (G:link / L1). No buses (700/70/777/…), no QR Gold Coast line (Helensvale–Varsity Lakes), no ferry in the oracle.
Timezone Australia/Brisbane NO DST. Same as Brisbane. Do not copy Sydney/Canberra/Newcastle HAS-DST.
One printed line: G:link, passenger number L1 from 9 August 2026. Termini Helensvale and Burleigh Heads. Broadbeach South remains an intermediate stop (former southern terminus).
Stage 3 Broadbeach South–Burleigh Heads is passenger-open on the official August 2026 tram map (solid line + inset) and on SEQ Version 4 GCLR3 10 Aug 2026. Inserted.

Locked rail-interchange printed name: Helensvale (tram map stop on the yellow line). Connecting-services box says Helensvale station. GTFS parent Helensvale station is SHARED with QR Gold Coast line — doNotGroup tram vs train platforms.

Locked long forms from the tram PDF: Queen Street, Nerang Street, Cypress Avenue, Cavill Avenue, Christine Avenue, Second Avenue. SEQ diagram abbreviates St/Ave. GTFS parents add station and, at two places, (Southport).
Arundel and Olsen Ave on the tram PDF are suburb/street labels, not stops. Not inserted.
gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown is the passenger code L1. SEQ feed route_id L1-5029 is versioned — do not treat the suffix as a print lock. No stopIds in this file.
coverageGaps: SEQ mixed map south of Burleigh Heads prints Twenty Seventh Ave, Nineteenth Ave, Palm Beach, Gold Coast Airport. Not on the G:link tram PDF. Not passenger-open as G:link. Not inserted.
Proposed western branch (Olsen Avenue / Labrador / Biggera Waters) is not on the August 2026 tram PDF. Not inserted.
QR Gold Coast line (Helensvale–Nerang–Robina–Varsity Lakes, plus Pimpama / Hope Island) is heavy rail. Out of this city. Brisbane T5 covers that corridor.
Weekday midnight–5am is bus replacement on the tram PDF frequency table (bus icon). Overlay, not a D1 line.
PDF hex colours are legend metadata, not D1 print locks. GTFS L1 colour FFC425 is feed metadata.
